raw_text: Nagaland on edge as NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown fears grow. Tribal organizations coordinating shutdown through encrypted Telegram channels and Facebook community groups. Protest logistics including road blockade locations at NH-29, NH-36, and district roads being shared. Situation volatile — Assam Rifles placed on standby.
clean_text: NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown fears in Nagaland. Tribal organizations coordinating shutdown via encrypted Telegram and Facebook. Road blockade locations on NH-29, NH-36 being shared. Assam Rifles on standby.
